mapper.select: SELECT slot_id AS id, available_time AS time, status, max_capacity AS maxCapacity, booked_count AS bookedCount FROM time_slots WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (member_id, post_id, slot_id, adult_count, child_count, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{dto.postId}, #{dto.slotId}, #{dto.adultCount}, #{dto.childCount}, 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE time_slots SET booked_count = booked_count + #{count}, status = CASE WHEN booked_count + #{count} >= max_capacity THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE status END WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, r.slot_id AS slotId, ps.available_date AS slotDate, ts.available_time AS slotTime, r.adult_count AS adultCount, r.child_count AS childCount, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM reservations r JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.post_id JOIN time_slots ts ON r.slot_id = ts.slot_id JOIN post_schedules ps ON ts.schedule_id = ps.schedule_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
